newsitem.title: UK: UPF shares gain as results please.
newsitem.headline: UPF shares gain as results please.

text.p: Shares in UPF Plc rose on Wednesday after the maker of pressings and fabrications for products ranging from Rolls-Royce cars to washing machines posted sharply higher profits and said the current year had started well.
The stock was up 11p at 138-1/2 by 1146 GMT in low volume of just 15,500 shares.
UPF posted a 19 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 6.7 million stg in the year ended August 31 from 5.7 million a year before and increased its interim dividend to 2.9p from 2.75p.
"The current year has started well and I believe that UPF has never neen better placed to take advantage of the opportunities available to it," said chairman Keith Evans.
Earnings per share rose to 12.05p from 10.06p and turnover increased to 55.4 million stg from 47.8 million.
